method: Warm processes, one pinned CPU, five alternating timed batches. Process CPU medians per solve; no conflict limit. Startup, compilation, parsing, model queries, statistics and IPC excluded. GC inside timed phases included. Both Lisp implementations audited against separate matched-allocator C servers for every iteration; all trace and model digests must match. Allocation counts are cumulative Lisp managed-heap allocations, excluding native arenas.
